anomalies.observed: The netlist contains two microcontrollers, U1 (ATtiny13V-10S) and U4 (ATtiny45-20P), and every corresponding pin is wired to the same net. For example, U1.1 and U4.1 are both on NET0006, U1.5 and U4.5 are both on NET0003, U1.6 and U4.6 are both on NET0010, and U1.8 and U4.8 are both on +5V.
anomalies.expected: The specification describes a single ATtiny-driven fan controller. A functional board should not have two MCUs simultaneously connected pin-for-pin unless one is explicitly an unpopulated alternate footprint; the provided files do not show that distinction.
anomalies.impact: If both MCUs are populated, their outputs drive the same I2C/ISP/fan-control/tach/pot nets, causing bus contention, unreliable fan control and programming, and possible damage to MCU outputs.

parsed.summary: The main deviation is that the netlist has two ATtiny microcontrollers wired pin-for-pin, while the intended fan controller is described as a single ATtiny-driven board; this would cause contention if both are assembled.
